reason: Adds a Git Remotes tab to a web sidebar for inspecting repository remotes and manually running fetch, fast-forward-only pull, and confirmed push operations.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏中增加 Git 远程标签页，用于查看分支与远程状态并手动执行 fetch、仅快进 pull 和确认后的 push。
summaries.en: Adds a Git Remotes tab to a web sidebar for viewing branch and remote status and manually running fetch, fast-forward-only pull, and confirmed push operations.

capabilities: Displays current Git branch, upstream, ahead/behind status, and remotes
Runs git fetch for all or a selected remote, with prune enabled by default
Runs git push after explicit panel confirmation
Uses the local Git credential helper or SSH agent for authentication
